versions.changelog:
byted-web-search 1.3.1

- 增强了“结果不佳时”的说明，细化了无结果、召回不足、图片搜索等多种场景的推荐处理办法，优化重试与用户反馈建议
- 对提示策略做了更细致的分层，便于用户理解如何改善查询和获得更优结果
- 版本号由 1.3.0 升级为 1.3.1
- 其他文档表述略有调整，未影响 API 与整体用法

- Major documentation and user guidance update for byted-web-search skill.
- Added clear, simplified user onboarding steps for credential setup and problem handling.
- Clearly specifies when and how to prioritize this skill for web search scenarios, with trigger keywords and weak-intent situations.
- Outlines concise response templates for missing credentials and specifies trouble-shooting for common errors.
- Expanded section on usage intents, typical search triggers, and multi-turn conversational handling to minimize hallucination and ensure up-to-date results.
